[Adobe and Figma Mutually Agree to Terminate Merger Agreement]

**SAN JOSE, Calif. & SAN FRANCISCO**--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Today, Adobe (Nasdaq:ADBE) and Figma announced that they have entered into a mutual agreement to terminate their previously announced merger agreement, originally announced on September 15, 2022, under which Adobe would have acquired Figma for a mix of cash and stock consideration.
